source_title: Star Wars: See an Exclusive Preview of The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu
source_excerpt:
Take a deep dive into the making of 2026's epic Star Wars movie.
Like any good Star Wars movie, The Mandalorian and Grogu was a massive undertaking that required the combined efforts of countless artists, designers, and prop makers. Now Abrams Books is celebrating that process with the release of The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu, a new hardcover book that offers a deep dive into the making of the film.
Ahead of the book's November 3 release, IGN can exclusively reveal a new look inside The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu. Check out the slideshow gallery below to see pages devoted to Mando's bounty hunter nemesis Embo and those eternally cute Anzellans:
The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu Preview Gallery
The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu is written by Phil Szostak and features interviews with numerous cast members and creatives who worked on the film, as well as hundreds of pieces of concept art and designs. Here's the official description for the book:
The Art of The Mandalorian and Grogu will be released on November 3. You can preorder a copy on Amazon .
In IGN's review of The Mandalorian and Grogu , Tom Jorgensen wrote, "The Mandalorian and Grogu dutifully offers another two hours and change of watching Din Djarin and his adorable green son fly to some planets and clear out rooms of monsters or gangsters every 20 minutes or so. But this is a Star Wars movie missing the thrills, the surprises, the challenges, the addition of really anything of note to the franchise, not to mention a vested interest in seeing its characters grow and change. This is not the way."
For more, brush up on every Star Wars movie and series in development .
